description: This file defines various attribute classes and related interfaces used for serialization, code generation, and remote procedure call support within the Orleans framework. It includes attributes for serializer generation, interface remoting, method invocation, and code generation metadata.

classes.name: GenerateSerializerAttribute
classes.description: Marks a type for which serialization code should be generated, specifying whether primary constructor parameters should be included and when field ids should be auto-assigned.

classes.name: GenerateMethodSerializersAttribute
classes.description: Marks an interface for which support code should be generated to enable remoting, specifying a proxy base type and whether it is an extension interface.

classes.name: InvokeMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Specifies the method name on the base type to invoke when submitting a request to an invokable interface.

classes.name: DefaultInvokeMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Defines the default method name for an interface or class, including the return type context.

classes.name: InvokableCustomInitializerAttribute
classes.description: Specifies a method to initialize invokable objects when invoked, possibly propagating attributes.

classes.name: DefaultInvokableBaseTypeAttribute
classes.description: Overrides the base type for invokable objects based on return type, including optional proxy method name.

classes.name: InvokableBaseTypeAttribute
classes.description: Associates a proxy base class and invokable base type with specific return types or proxy classes.

classes.name: GetCompletionSourceMethodNameAttribute
classes.description: Defines the method to get a completion source for asynchronous requests.

classes.name: IdAttribute
classes.description: Assigns a unique identifier to a member, class, struct, enum or method to aid serialization.

classes.name: OrleansConstructorAttribute
classes.description: Specifies the constructor to use during serialization instantiation, extending ActivatorUtilitiesConstructorAttribute.

classes.name: AliasAttribute
classes.description: Marks a type or method with a well-known, unique alias for serialization or identification.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasAttribute
classes.description: Defines a compound alias composed of multiple components, used to label types.

classes.name: RegisterProviderAttribute
classes.description: Declares a provider (e.g., clustering or reminder) for automatic registration, associated with an assembly.

classes.name: RegisterSerializerAttribute
classes.description: Indicates a class or struct as a serializer to be registered automatically.

classes.name: RegisterActivatorAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class or struct as an activator to be registered for object creation.

classes.name: RegisterCopierAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class or struct as a copier implementation for serialization.

classes.name: RegisterConverterAttribute
classes.description: Marks a class or struct as a converter to be registered.

classes.name: UseActivatorAttribute
classes.description: Indicates that a type should be instantiated via a registered activator.

classes.name: SuppressReferenceTrackingAttribute
classes.description: Prevents reference tracking for serializers of the marked type, avoiding cyclic object graph support.

classes.name: OmitDefaultMemberValuesAttribute
classes.description: Could be used to omit serialization of members with default values for optimization.

classes.name: ImmutableAttribute
classes.description: Marks a type or member as immutable, signaling that copying or tracking references is unnecessary.

classes.name: SerializerTransparentAttribute
classes.description: Indicates the type should be invisible for serialization, effectively removing it from hierarchy.

classes.name: ApplicationPartAttribute
classes.description: Indicates an assembly as a component part of the application, to be included in source generation.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksAttribute
classes.description: Associates a hook class to invoke during serialization or deserialization.

classes.name: GeneratedActivatorConstructorAttribute
classes.description: Designates a constructor for use by generated activator code, allowing dependency injection.

classes.name: GenerateCodeForDeclaringAssemblyAttribute
classes.description: Instructs source generation to include another assembly via a type within it.

classes.name: ResponseTimeoutAttribute
classes.description: Sets a response timeout value for interface method calls.

classes.name: IConverter
classes.description: Defines an interface for converting between a value type and a surrogate representation.

classes.name: IPopulator
classes.description: Defines an interface for populating a class instance from a surrogate type.

classes.name: ReturnValueProxyAttribute
classes.description: Marks invokable classes to immediately return their derived type instead of passing to runtime invocation, supporting patterns like streaming.
